title: Authentic h1 class correspondence completion
objective: Publish and cold-replay an internal upstream-assumed correspondence-complete class witness for the authentic h=1 cubic from full exact presentation authority, while keeping every public certification flag false

oracles: exact Smith replay with vacuous generator-order witness set

handoff.summary: Added a new-files-only immutable internal class-correspondence witness for the authentic h=1 real cubic. Cold replay retains the full exact presentation authority, reconstructs 66 factor-base ideals, verifies 73 principal relations, reruns relation HNF and Smith transformations, and proves that the resulting factor-base presentation is trivial. It records the sole remaining class-side leap—the global generation of the ideal class group by PARI's selected factor base—as a pinned upstream assumption. Class correspondence is complete only under that assumption; phase5, public class completion, and public class/unit completion stay false.
risks: Global factor-base generation is accepted from the pinned PARI 2.17.4 policy and is not independently proved by this internal witness.
The result is intentionally field-specific and dynamic Python; it is a correctness/status boundary rather than a timed native kernel.
Only the focused Linux-x64 replay and syntax/format checks were run in this lane; broad baselib/native suites remain for integration.
next_steps: Attach this class-only status to the authentic final internal result without mapping it to ClassUnitComputation.complete.
Supply a certified maximal-order/factor-base theorem and replayable global saturation record before any public class-complete promotion.
